description: Furnish your home with Seville Classics' Foldable Tufted Storage Ottoman in Midnight Blue. Remove the tufted cushion top to reveal a generous storage area for organizing magazines, blankets, linens, toys, remotes and more! Doubles as a plush footrest in the living room and is ideal for use as a stool in communal work spaces, dorm halls, or commercial environments like lounges. Folding design means the cube sets up in seconds and uses little space in storage. Unit is lightweight (less than 8 lbs.) and folds away easily when out of use.
